g.text: Agree acceptance, preserve evidence, test the repair
Prepare valuable work, retain inspectable evidence and make the next change an accountable experiment.

Name the practitioner, accepted work product and critical limits. Compare quality, coverage and total human effort against a credible baseline. Preparation time, tool volume and rollout scope answer useful but different questions from financial impact.

Carry entity, meaning, period, source version, access and calculation through the final artifact. Give memory a correction and aging policy. Keep professional review and permission to act as separate events, with durable workflow state between them.
Make the next change a test

Choose one failure mechanism and a bounded comparison. Score final output, consequential behavior and authority; inspect paired regressions. Preserve the case and correction so improvement becomes a team asset rather than a lesson one person must rediscover.
Sources: Range · Kepler · Basis · Blackstone / Norm.ai · Citadel Securities | Reviewed October 25, 2026
